evals.name: SPA Hydration & Accessibility Tree Snapshotting
evals.prompt: Navigate to an Angular single-page application utilizing Signals reactivity, synchronize component hydration, and extract interactive element UIDs via accessibility tree snapshotting.
evals.expected_output: Verifies server readiness, waits for reactive signal resolution, executes take_snapshot, maps element UIDs without blind sleep delays, and prepares interaction targets.
assertions: Verifies dev server port reachability prior to browser navigation
Waits for signal hydration and network idle before DOM query
Executes take_snapshot to retrieve compact accessibility tree and element UIDs
Discovers interactive element UIDs without relying on brittle CSS selectors

evals.name: WCAG 2.1 AA Mobile Touch Target & Contrast Audit
evals.prompt: Audit a mobile web page layout on a 375px viewport for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, checking touch target sizes and text contrast ratios.
evals.expected_output: Inspects touch targets for 44x44px minimum bounding box, verifies 4.5:1 text contrast ratio, and checks semantic landmarks.
assertions: Enforces minimum 44x44px touch target dimensions on mobile controls
Verifies normal body text maintains at least 4.5:1 contrast against surface
Validates presence of single h1 tag and semantic landmarks
Outputs structured audit results with identified pass/fail criteria

evals.name: Interactive UI State Assertion & Visual Verification
evals.prompt: Trigger a form submission flow in the browser, assert reactive DOM mutation, capture a visual screenshot artifact, and update the walkthrough report.
evals.expected_output: Interacts with form inputs via explicit UIDs, re-takes snapshot to verify updated DOM state, saves screenshot artifact to brain, and documents visual proof.
assertions: Interacts with form controls using explicit element UIDs
Re-fetches DOM snapshot after state mutation to confirm DOM update
Captures visual screenshot and saves to active workspace brain directory
Rejects speculative execution without empirical DOM or visual proof
